quality_tiers.A: Independent high-confidence scientific certification; no records assigned in this build
quality_tiers.B: Evidence-supported automatic/source-inspected record; never human-expert verified
quality_tiers.C: Candidate/incomplete source or attribution; exploratory only

analysis_ready_scaffold: All source Paper/Material identities are retained; only admitted scientific nodes and relations are analysis-ready
identities: Materials and aliases are strictly paper-scoped. Substance normalization never merges material instances. Measurement IDs are preserved.
synthesis: V4 explicit transformations only; legacy partial operations retained when independently supported; operation and family scope remain explicit
deduplication: Explicit source_measurement_id and exact same paper, sample, role, evidence and original quantity/ratio identity create DERIVED_FROM links. CORROBORATES supplies added source/test context and does not create another independent observation. Equal numerical values alone are never merged.
missing_values: Blank/unknown retained; no confidence probabilities or inferred masses, yields, temperatures, configurations or electrolytes.

quality_axes.stable_node_identity: All KG1 IDs retained; paper-scoped material keys; aliases never merge samples
quality_axes.source_supported: KG1 independent admitted source checks OR V4 AUTO_PDF_CONFIRMED, minus explicit V4 quarantine/conflicting operations
quality_axes.strict_ready: Membership in authoritative Analysis_Ready, only the 175 canonical V4 fact representations
quality_axes.v4_curated: Membership in authoritative Curated_Facts, 776 fact representations
quality_axes.analysis_ready: Legacy independently admitted eligibility retained when unaddressed; explicit V4 records inherit V4 strict eligibility. Use task views for pooling.
quality_axes.observations: Explicit pointers and equal paper, material, canonical property, value, unit and no conflicting known protocol/recipe; equal numbers alone do not merge
quality_axes.ratio_policy: ZnO/Gelatin recipe direction, RAW_PRECURSOR denominator, dual template/in-situ role and exact synthesis-step scope retained
quality_axes.legacy_wide_material_columns: V3 summaries; canonical observations and task views are authoritative for KG2 analyses
